{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_filtered = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = df_filtered[(df_filtered['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_filtered['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute total revenue and number of orders
total_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()
num_orders = len(df_loyal_completed)
mean_revenue = total_revenue / num_orders

# Print the values to ensure they are reported from code
print(f"total_revenue: {total_revenue}")
print(f"num_orders: {num_orders}")
print(f"mean_revenue: {mean_revenue}")

# Return mean_revenue for submission
mean_revenue"}
